title: Bubble Blowing Solution
ingredients: a few drops of food coloring
directions: In a 1 quart jar put: 1 oz liquid detergent, 1 tsp sugar, 4 tbsp glycerine, a few drops of food coloring.
Fill up with water & shake.
raw_text:
BUBBLE BLOWING SOLUTION
IN A 1 QUART JAR. PUT:
1 oz. liquid detergent
1 TSP. SUGAR.
4 TBSP. GLYCERINE
A FEW DROPS OF FOOD COLORING.
FILL UP WITH WATER & SHAKE.

title: Crabmeat Dip
directions: Place cream cheese, cottage cheese & mayonnaise in mixer bowl. - mix - Beat about 1 min. until well blended.
Stop & scrape bowl. Add all remaining ingred. - Beat about 1 min. until all ingred. are combined.
Refrigerate until well chilled. Serve c̄ assort. crackers.
raw_text:
Crabmeat Dip. re Mary Ann.
1 pkg. light cream - 8 oz.        1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 c cottage cheese.               3 " chopped green onions
1/4 c mayonnaise                  1/2 tsp. garlic salt.
1 c crabmeat, flaked.             3 drops hot pepper sauce.
Place cream cheese, cottage cheese & mayonnaise in
mixer bowl. - mix - Beat about 1 min. until well blended.
Stop & scrape bowl. Add all remaining ingred. - Beat about
1 min. until all ingred. are combined.
Refrigerate until well chilled. Serve c̄ assort. crackers.

title: Mead Liquor
directions: Boil 1/2 hour (simmer) - Skim off scum as it forms. Add peel of 2 lemons (grate peel only).
Pour into crock to cool to blood heat.
Small quantity yeast (almost pkg) mix with warm water & add to mixture when cool.
Add spices (cinnamon stick). Leave in crock - 6 months - strain - bottle for 6 months.
N.B. Mrs. Chudinia left in crock 2 months
notes: N.B. about Mrs. [Chudinia?] continues onto next photo
